subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Solemn
solution: The correct answer is '**Dignified**'. ***__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Solemn**' is '**Dignified**'. • **Solemn**: (used about a person) very serious; not happy or smiling. [(व्‍यक्ति) गंभीर, गम्भीर या गहरी गंभीरता से पूर्ण] • *Example: Her **solemn** face told them that the news was bad.* • **Dignified**: behaving in a calm, serious way that makes other people respect you. (किसी ऐसी चीज या व्यक्ति का वर्णन करता है जो गंभीर, शांत और सम्मान के योग्य हो) • *Example: **dignified** behaviour...* **Correct Answer:__** Dignified.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Excited**: feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm; not calm. (उत्तेजित, व्‍यग्र; अधीर) • **Trivial**: of little importance; not worth considering. (महत्वहीन, मामूली; नगण्य, तुच्‍छ) • **Frivolous**: not serious; silly. (अगंभीर; मूर्खतापूर्ण) 16e:Tded, The correct answer is **'Ritu was invited for a party by Preeti.'**
